fusions.name: Red-Hot Gibbet
fusions.desc: Drops a cage of red-hot bars over a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It holds the target stunned for 1.2 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Brazier
fusions.desc: Closes a ring of burning bars around you that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, always as a critical hit, and leaves each [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bars of Flame
fusions.desc: Raises a row of red-hot bars 5 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it, sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Portcullis
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, bars of flame close around you: you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds, and for the first 5 seconds the bars burn your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
